name: Announcement Bar (Extended)
summary: Announcement Bar presentation extensions for countdown content, rotating slides, and an optional dismiss action without deciding capability composition or rotation behavior.

anatomy.name: countdownRoot
anatomy.description: Registry selector and flex layout for announcement content with countdown values.

anatomy.name: dismissibleRoot
anatomy.description: Optional positioning context for a dismiss action.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Size remains owned by the Announcement Bar dependency.

states.name: dismissHover
states.description: Pointer hover on the optional dismiss button.

states.name: dismissFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the optional dismiss button.

behavior.name: baseComposition
behavior.description: Every extension composes the Announcement Bar dependency and preserves its message and link obligations.

behavior.name: rotationPresentation
behavior.description: Canonical CSS demonstrates a fixed visual loop only; the source contract does not define message count, cadence, pausing, controls, synchronization, or whether rotation combines with other extensions.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The optional native button requests dismissal; the target owns persistence, focus destination, and whether the announcement may return.

properties.name: slides
properties.description: Optional repeated announcement messages for the existing rotating presentation; this does not define rotation behavior.

properties.name: dismissAction
properties.description: Optional native button that requests announcement dismissal.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the optional dismiss button.

accessibility: Preserve the Announcement Bar dependency's readable message and native-link semantics.
Provide a named native dismiss button when dismissal is offered.
Do not rotate critical legal, checkout, or safety information.
Pause or replace automatic rotation when an accepted rotation model is introduced, and disable the current CSS animation for reduced motion.
Do not infer that countdown, rotation, and dismissal are mutually exclusive or freely composable until that product boundary is accepted.

web.notes: Presentation CSS exists; capability composition and rotation behavior remain unresolved.
